## Open Science

Everyone can fork this repository. Use this example to journal your lab work and assignments.

We, Jochem Tolsma and Bas Hofstra, use this repository for our Social Network Analysis For Social Scientists course [@SNASS]. <!--- this is a reference, stored in references.bib. It will be automatically added at the bottom of the page --->
:::

## How to use

1.  Fork the repository for this website and follow instructions on `README` to get started [here](https://github.com/JochemTolsma/labjournal).

2.  Journal your work, by editing the .Rmd-files

3.  ...

4.  Change everything to make it your own!

<br>

Use the top menu to navigate through the journal.

##Week 1 Seminar

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)

```

```{r}
tesvariable <- 4
anothertestvariable <- 6
#look in your environment tab. You now see you have something there. 
ls()
list = ls()
list
ls()
rm(list)
ls()
#? :-)
rm(list=ls())
ls()

?ls

```


```{r}

cv08 <- haven::read_sav(file = "Cultural_Changes_2008.sav")
cv10 <- haven::read_sav(file = "Cultural_Changes_2010.sav")

head(names(cv08))
?head
summary(cv08)
head(cv08)
str(cv08, 3)
# what happens if you change the 1 with a 2 or 3? Check the help function or just try and see.
class(cv08)
attributes(cv08)

```
```{r}
table(cv08$lftop, useNA = "always")
cv08$lftop_new <- cv08$lftop
cv08$lftop_new[cv08$lftop_new == 99] <- NA

table(cv08$lftop_new, useNA = "always")
attributes(cv08$lftop_new)
attr(cv08$lftop, "labels")

```
```{r}
cv08 <- mutate(.data = cv08, lftop_new = na_if(lftop, 99))
table(cv08$lftop_new, useNA = "always")


cv08 %>%
  mutate(
    educ3 = case_match(
      var006n,
      c(-3, -1, 10) ~ "missing",
      c(1) ~ "primary",
      c(2, 3, 4) ~ "secondary",
      c(5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "tertiary"
    ),
    educ3 = as.factor(educ3)
  ) -> cv08

table(cv08$educ3)

class(cv08$geslacht)
attributes(cv08$geslacht)$labels
table(cv08$geslacht, useNA = "always")

cv08 <- cv08 %>%
    mutate(geslacht_n = case_match(geslacht, "9" ~ NA, "M" ~ 0, "V" ~ 1))

cv08 <- cv08 %>%
  mutate(geslacht_n = recode_values(geslacht, "9" ~ NA, "M" ~ 0, "V" ~ 1), geslacht_n = labelled(geslacht_n,
        labels = c(man = 0, vrouw = 1)))

table(cv08$geslacht_n)

```
